blocks.raw: # Configure Viber Content
Viber is an app-based instant messaging platform. You can create a new message or use existing templates and customize the message content as required.
blocks.text: Viber is an app-based instant messaging platform. You can create a new message or use existing templates and customize the message content as required.

blocks.raw: You can create channel content for a campaign while creating a message. To navigate to the Content section, see [create a campaign](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-campaign).
blocks.text: You can create channel content for a campaign while creating a message. To navigate to the Content section, see create a campaign.

blocks.raw: # Configure viber content
To configure the Viber content, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To configure the Viber content, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. In the **Content** section, click **Add creative**.
2. Navigate to the **Viber** tab
blocks.text: In the Content section, click Add creative.Navigate to the Viber tab

3. Create a new Viber message or select from the existing template(creatives).
4. Click **Create new**.

5. Enter the message name.
6. In **Text Message**, enter the message content (up to 1000 characters) text. You can also **add labels** to the text message such as coupon code, customer's full name, store name, store address, and more. You can also use Liquid language in the messages.
7. In **Image**, upload the image from the local device or gallery if required.\
   The image you upload needs to have the following properties.

blocks.raw:
* Image dimension: 300 x 400 pixels.
* Image size should not exceed 10 MB.
blocks.text: Image dimension: 300 x 400 pixels.Image size should not exceed 10 MB.

blocks.raw: 8. To include links in the message (if required), do this.
blocks.text: To include links in the message (if required), do this.

blocks.raw:
* In **Button text**, enter the label name (up to 20 characters) for the button.
* In **Button URL** enter the URL to open when the recipient clicks on the button. Only secured URL is supported ( https\://...).
blocks.text: In Button text, enter the label name (up to 20 characters) for the button.In Button URL enter the URL to open when the recipient clicks on the button. Only secured URL is supported ( https://...).

blocks.text: (Optional) Select Preview and Test to preview the message content and test it with a set of test customers before sending it.

blocks.raw: ## Configure viber message
To configure a Viber message using an existing template, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To configure a Viber message using an existing template, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. Select your preferred template from the list. You can also use the template name in the search option to fetch a specific template.
2. Modify **Text Message**, **Image**, and **Button**(text and URL) if required.
3. Click **Done**.
